paragraphs.text: I am focused at least on the eight; if it gets us another ore, I might use the port toward a city.
uncertainties: Whether an eight will roll and yield another ore is uncertain.

paragraphs.text: I react with surprise: wow; well, we'll take that—jeez.
uncertainties: What I am reacting to is unspecified.

paragraphs.text: I want to see a seven here; I think it would really light things up.
I call the four incredible—an incredible play.
I like that my brick eight and ore eight are coordinated; that is really nice.
I repeatedly say no, then change to yes.
The last couple of rolls have been really juicy for us—really nice.
I would take a wheat if the other player has one, though I do not know whether he has an extra. That would be a great deal for me and put me over.
uncertainties: Whether the other player has an extra wheat is uncertain.
What threshold the deal would put me over is unspecified.

paragraphs.text: An eight does not do it, and I think he is killing it.
uncertainties: The player referred to as ‘he’ is not identified.

paragraphs.text: I think it would be really nice to get the settlement down.
I cheer, say all right, call for a 10, and then say, ‘All right, perfect.’
uncertainties: What prompts the final reaction is unspecified.

paragraphs.text: I think I'll block the five.
